basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Advanced Software Engineer · Site Reliability (SRE) & Cloud Infrastructure · Terraform · Kubernetes · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.honeywell-sre-infra: Advanced Software Engineer with 3.5+ years designing, operating, and troubleshooting distributed, event-driven cloud systems across AWS, Azure, and GCP — hands-on with Terraform/HCL infrastructure-as-code, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Datadog/OpenTelemetry monitoring. Cut resource-discovery latency 70–90% by migrating 35+ Azure governance modules to an event-driven architecture at Turbot HQ, one of 120+ merged pull requests across Turbot's 9,300★ open-source suite.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team on system reliability and uptime to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to an event-driven architecture via Azure Event Grid (from polling), cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for manual investigation and debugging.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — added multi-distro Linux smoke tests to the GitHub Actions release pipeline and unified release/version workflows, automated Slack notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging, improving release safety, repeatability, and traceability — all shipped through peer code review via GitHub pull requests.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS v4–v6, Azure v2.1–v4.0, GCP v3–v4, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, GitHub), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks — used by enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government — cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

projects.name: SLA Tracking Dashboard for an Open-Source Tools Team
projects.description: 651 lines of dashboard config (HCL + SQL) for a public OSS repo: per-repo SLA-tracking status cards across 8 repositories (Awaiting Initial Response, Needs Triage, Awaiting Author Feedback, Stale Issues, Total Age) with threshold-coded indicators, giving the team ongoing visibility into service-level performance. Lateral-join SQL against the Steampipe GitHub plugin tables detects zero-org-comment issues — replacing manual repo-by-repo triage with a single dashboard.
